scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:preload
scripts.dev: npm run build && node dist/src/main/agent-support/prepare-dev-cli.js && node dist/src/main/dev/launcher.js
scripts.prepare:sparkle: npm run setup:sparkle && npm run build:sparkle
scripts.pack: npm run prepare:windows-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --dir
scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:sparkle && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:prepared: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:windows-runtime && npm run dist:prepared
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:sparkle && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.publish: npm run prepare:windows-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish always
